data.body: Final stocktake disposition unchanged. The direction remains 4/4 OSS-consensus-backed and the measured projection remains about 75s macOS wall / 207 runner-seconds, but neither adding a Git library, hand-parsing all ref/storage formats, nor removing the checkout-attribution guard meets the session fidelity and automatic-approval bar. The RAM-disk experiment did not create an alternative route; it was slower and reverted in Gerrit 1806. Keep this ticket in_progress for explicit operator disposition or new evidence; no implementation is approved automatically, and this pause does not claim its acceptance criteria are complete.
